Modifications in Bar Control:
- The original cat, coffee, dog, drop, engine, mochi, Newton cradle, and slime PNG frames are loaded directly by AppKit.
- Users can select the animation from Bar Control's menu; the selection is stored locally.
- Frame timing is driven by whole-machine power instead of CPU utilization.
- The frames are scaled and tinted for the Touch Bar.
